relations.subject: Frederick Eden Pargiter
relations.evidence: Studies at Oxford (Exeter College), mathematics, Sanskrit, etc.

relations.subject: Frederick Eden Pargiter
relations.evidence: In 1875 he joined the Bengal Civil Service serving mainly in Eastern Bengal.

relations.subject: Frederick Eden Pargiter
relations.evidence: From 1904 Judge of the High Court, Calcutta. Retired in 1906

relations.subject: Frederick Eden Pargiter
relations.evidence: In India he was an active member of the A.S.B. and in 1903-05 its President.

relations.subject: Frederick Eden Pargiter
relations.evidence: In England he was active in the R.A.S. and as its secretary in 1924 edited the Centenary Volume .

relations.subject: Frederick Eden Pargiter
relations.evidence: He assisted Hoerne in the publication of Central Asian manuscript fragments.

relations.subject: Frederick Eden Pargiter
relations.evidence: In England Fleet led him to epigraphy, for which he made some notable contributions.
